import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Credit Card Fraud Detection Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Color palette for fraud/non-fraud
fraud_palette = {0: '#2ecc71', 1: '#e74c3c'}
fraud_labels = {0: 'Legitimate', 1: 'Fraud'}

# 1. Transaction Amount Distribution by Fraud Status
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for fraud_status in [0, 1]:
    subset = df[df['is_fraud'] == fraud_status]['amount']
    ax1.hist(subset, bins=30, alpha=0.6, label=fraud_labels[fraud_status], 
             color=fraud_palette[fraud_status], edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution by Fraud Status', fontsize=12)
ax1.legend()
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Fraud Rate by Transaction Type
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
fraud_by_type = df.groupby('transaction_type')['is_fraud'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
fraud_by_type['fraud_rate'] = (fraud_by_type['sum'] / fraud_by_type['count']) * 100
fraud_by_type = fraud_by_type.sort_values('fraud_rate', ascending=True)

bars = ax2.barh(fraud_by_type.index, fraud_by_type['fraud_rate'], 
                color=sns.color_palette('RdYlGn_r', len(fraud_by_type)), edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Fraud Rate (%)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Fraud Rate by Transaction Type', fontsize=12)

# Add value labels on bars
for bar, rate in zip(bars, fraud_by_type['fraud_rate']):
    ax2.text(bar.get_width() + 0.5, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, 
             f'{rate:.1f}%', va='center', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_xlim(0, max(fraud_by_type['fraud_rate']) * 1.15)
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Hourly Transaction Pattern with Fraud Overlay
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
hourly_stats = df.groupby('hour_of_day').agg({
    'is_fraud': ['sum', 'count']
}).reset_index()
hourly_stats.columns = ['hour', 'fraud_count', 'total_count']
hourly_stats['legitimate_count'] = hourly_stats['total_count'] - hourly_stats['fraud_count']

ax3.bar(hourly_stats['hour'], hourly_stats['legitimate_count'], 
        label='Legitimate', color='#2ecc71', alpha=0.8)
ax3.bar(hourly_stats['hour'], hourly_stats['fraud_count'], 
        bottom=hourly_stats['legitimate_count'], label='Fraud', color='#e74c3c', alpha=0.8)
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Transaction Volume by Hour (Stacked by Fraud Status)', fontsize=12)
ax3.legend(loc='upper right')
ax3.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Box Plot: Amount by Transaction Type and Fraud Status
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df['fraud_label'] = df['is_fraud'].map(fraud_labels)
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='fraud_label',
            palette={'Legitimate': '#2ecc71', 'Fraud': '#e74c3c'}, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Amount Distribution by Transaction Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=12)
ax4.legend(title='Status')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Add summary statistics as text
total_transactions = len(df)
total_fraud = df['is_fraud'].sum()
fraud_rate = (total_fraud / total_transactions) * 100
avg_fraud_amount = df[df['is_fraud'] == 1]['amount'].mean()
avg_legit_amount = df[df['is_fraud'] == 0]['amount'].mean()

summary_text = f'Summary Statistics:\n'
summary_text += f'Total Transactions: {total_transactions:,}\n'
summary_text += f'Fraud Cases: {total_fraud:,} ({fraud_rate:.2f}%)\n'
summary_text += f'Avg Fraud Amount: ${avg_fraud_amount:.2f}\n'
summary_text += f'Avg Legit Amount: ${avg_legit_amount:.2f}'

fig.text(0.02, 0.02, summary_text, fontsize=10, verticalalignment='bottom',
         bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.5))

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.08, 1, 0.96])
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
